context:
REVIEW 2026-10-25: acceptance rewritten because 330 s was the fastest of five pre-incident runs (range 328-552 s, runner speed varies about 1.7x). PR #3462 head 43c6a7ecd: 34,024 passed, 67 skipped in 418.37 s (run 40211462226), collection 61.4 s, test phase 356.7 s, versus run 40143651006 collection 60.4 s, test phase 346.6 s: 2.9% slower with 1.4% more tests. Probe cost: 22-26 ms per call in an idle Linux container, but about 1.3-1.8 s per call in the real suite (estimated from similar-speed runners, 447-469 s before vs 953-964 s after #3423; the gc.collect on the large heap dominates); the probe now runs only after modules that opened chDB (test_clickhouse_local.py and a few in test_clickhouse_adapter.py). Known gap: a connection opened during collection or in a session- or package-scoped fixture is no longer flagged (none exists today).
